pageProps.title: About Death
pageProps.review: A review of the webtoon About Death, where God, as an observer rather than a judge, listens to the stories of the deceased and makes them realize the truth, regrets, and precious values of life on their own.
pageProps.description: The boundary between life and death, and what story can you tell now?
pageProps.content:
## Review A ```God``` who is an observer rather than omnipotent appears, and does not directly intervene in human fate. Miracles such as bringing the dead back to life or preventing a destined death are not his role.
He is not a judge, but a mirror that makes the deceased look back on their lives themselves. And he listens to the final stories of the deceased. In this process, the deceased realize for themselves the truths, regrets, and precious values they had ignored in their lives.
Each episode consists of chilling stories about death, and gives new meaning and emotion every time it is read and pondered.
